'''Clarice''' (Japanese: '''クラリス''' ''Clarisse'') is a recurring character in ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]''. She is a [[Pokémon Performer]].

==History==
Clarice first appeared in ''[[XY060|A Showcase Debut!]]'', where she competed in the [[Coumarine City]] [[Pokémon Showcase]]. She was first shown in the preparing room for Pokémon Performers. She was later called onstage to perform in the first round, together with {{an|Serena}} and {{an|Blanche}}. As part of the theme of the first round, "Pokémon Styling", Clarice decorated Fletchling with a tie and a top hat. It wasn't enough to proceed, however, as she didn't get enough votes from the audience and fell slightly behind Blanche.

In ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'', Clarice competed in the [[Fleurrh City]] Pokémon Showcase. However, once again, she did not make it to the Freestyle Performance.

In ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'' and ''[[XY113|Performing a Pathway to the Future!]]'', Clarice competed in the Master Class Pokémon Showcase in [[Gloire City]]. In the first round, her performance didn't get enough votes from the audience, and as such, she was eliminated from the tournament.

As part of the theme of the first round, "Pokémon Styling", Clarice decorated Fletchling with a tie and a top hat. It wasn't enough to proceed however, and Clarice and Fletchling were eliminated.

It reappeared in ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'', where it competed alongside its Trainer in the [[Fleurrh City]] Pokémon Showcase, but they were once again eliminated in the Theme Performance.

It appeared again in ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'' and ''[[XY113|Performing a Pathway to the Future!]]'', where it competed alongside its Trainer in the {{ci|Gloire}} Master Class Showcase. In the first round, its performance didn't get enough votes from the audience, and as such, it and its Trainer were eliminated from the tournament.

Fletchling's only known move is {{m|Double Team}}.}}
